prw: prw — coming forth, appearance, a god's going out in procession (noun m.; from pri 'go forth')
šwt: šwt — feather, plume (noun f.; dual šwty 'the two plumes' of a crown; Budge: śuti)
ḏrt: ḏrt — kite, the bird of prey; ḏrty 'the two kites', Isis and Nephthys as mourners of Osiris (noun f.; Budge: t'ertutu)
sꜣk: sꜣk — to gather, draw together, collect (verb; reading not sure; Budge: sàka)
irt: irt — eye (noun f.; dual irty 'the two eyes')
iwt: iwt — wrong, misdeed, evil (noun f.; written with the bird of bad things; reading of the first sign not sure; Budge: āut)
ḫsr: ḫsr — to drive away, dispel (evil, wrongs) (verb; Budge: χersek)
šꜥd: šꜥd — to cut, cut off (verb; infinitive šꜥd 'a cutting')
ẖpꜣ: ẖpꜣ — navel, navel cord (noun m.; reading and sense not sure here; Budge: χapaa)
sḥri: sḥri — to remove, drive away, put far off (verb; causative of ḥri 'be far')
wꜣḏ-wr: wꜣḏ-wr — 'the Great Green', the sea or a great body of water; here the name of one of the two nests (place name; Budge: Uat'-urà)
ḥsmn: ḥsmn — natron, the salt used for cleansing and purifying (noun m.; Budge: ḥesmen)
mꜥꜣt: mꜥꜣt — a substance or place named beside natron, not identified (noun f.; written with the house classifier; not Maat; Budge: Māāāat; reading and sense uncertain)
š-mꜣꜥt: š-mꜣꜥt — 'the Lake of Maat', a lake of Abydos in the world below (place name; Budge: Śe-Maāat)
kꜣri: kꜣri — shrine, chapel (noun m.; Budge: kerà)
ḏsr: ḏsr — holy, sacred, set apart (adjective; verb 'be holy, set apart'; reading doubtful here; Budge took it as a name, sert)
bꜣḥ: bꜣḥ — presence (noun; m-bꜣḥ 'in the presence of'; imyw-bꜣḥ 'those who are in the presence', the gods before the creator; Budge: baḥ)
wꜣi: wꜣi — to set out, start on (a road); wꜣ r with an infinitive 'set about, begin to' (verb; Budge: ua)
ḥw: ḥw — Hu, the god of the commanding word, the creator's utterance (god's name; Budge: Ḥu)
mḥ: mḥ — to fill, fill up (verb; mḥ wḏꜣt 'fill the Eye', make it whole)
hꜣb: hꜣb — a verb of harm or loss said of the Eye, not otherwise known in this sense (verb; Budge: hab; reading and meaning uncertain)
rḥwy: rḥwy — the Two Companions, Horus and Seth (dual noun, from rḥ 'companion'; Budge: Reḥu)
nšny: nšny — storm, raging (noun; from nšn 'rage'; Budge: neśeni)

__broaden__.nḏ: nḏ — to protect, guard (verb) · nḏ-ḥr, 'protect, care for', literally 'look after the face of' (compound with ḥr 'face'; participle nḏ-ḥr itf·f 'who protects his father', a name of Horus)
__broaden__.mn: mn — to be firm, established, to endure (verb 2-lit; stative mn 'is established, lasting') · a second word of the same spelling: to suffer, be ill; ailment, suffering (verb, noun; written with the bird of bad things)
__broaden__.sš: sš — scribe (noun; the palette-and-pen sign) · a second word of the same spelling: to pass, go through (verb; doubtful here) · also to write, draw, paint (verb; written with the scribe's palette) · also the noun 'writing, document, record' (noun m.) · also to open (a door), spread open (verb; said of doors and bolts) · a further word of the same spelling: nest (noun m.; written with the nest of young birds; dual sšwy)
__broaden__.šn: šn — to revile, curse(?) (verb; reading and sense uncertain, perhaps for šnṯ 'revile') · a second word of the same spelling: hair (noun; written with the cord šn and the lock of hair; Budge: śen)
__broaden__.·w: ·w — ending of the 3rd person masculine singular of the stative ('he is …ed'; often not written) · also the 3rd person plural 'they' of later Egyptian, written w (doubtful here, after ꜥḥꜥ·n)
__broaden__.ꜥḥꜥ: ꜥḥꜥ — to stand, stand up (verb); standing-place, stand, support (noun; plural ꜥḥꜥw) · also ꜥḥꜥ·n 'then', the auxiliary that opens a narrative sentence
__broaden__.gr: gr — to be silent, still (verb) · a second word of nearly the same spelling: the particle grt 'now, moreover, indeed' · the particle grt apparently also written ẖrt, with the sign ẖr, after ir and in (reading not sure)
__broaden__.wꜥb: wꜥb — to be pure, clean; to purify oneself, bathe (verb); pure (adjective) · also wꜥb 'wab-priest', the 'pure one', a priest of the ordinary rank (noun) · also wꜥb 'purification, purity' (noun)
__broaden__.m: m — in, from (preposition) · also "with" (instrument), "as" (m bnw "as the Bennu"), "on" (living on), "by"; im before a suffix (im·i, im·f, im·tn) · a second word of the same spelling: what? (interrogative pronoun; r m 'for what? why?') · also 'among' (with a group of people) · also the negative imperative 'do not!' (before a verb form: m irt 'do not make'; from the verb imi) · also written mꜥ, with the arm, in later copies
__broaden__.stꜣt: stꜣt — excrement (?) (noun; not otherwise known: the reading and sense follow Budge's setat, and are doubtful) · also written stw, without ꜣ
__broaden__.pwy: pwy — this, that (masculine demonstrative, after its noun; hrw pwy 'that day') · also standing for pw 'it is' in a sentence without a verb
__broaden__.ẖrt: ẖrt — what belongs to someone, affairs, concerns; possessions (noun) · ẖrt hrw 'the daily round, what belongs to the day'
